topics.name: Package and Integrity Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for package identities, manifests, member hashes, provenance and integrity verification state.

semantics.identity_rule: Package, member artifact, hash evidence, publisher and installed artifact identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: verify/import/install operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/verifying package grants no install authority.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

hard_gates.condition: publisher shown as trusted authority automatically
